headline: Brazil's CNI Lowers 2026 GDP Forecast to 1.6% Amid Inflation Pressure
summary: The National Confederation of Industry cut its 2026 economic growth forecast for Brazil from 2.0% to 1.6%. The industrial group raised its year-end inflation outlook to 5.15% and projected the public debt-to-GDP ratio reaching 83.7%.
why: CNI forecasts offer an authoritative snapshot of industrial activity, fiscal health, and inflationary risks in Latin America's largest economy.
